Why Did Costco Stock Fall Today? Because It Had ‘Little Room for Error’
Costco’s $250 Billion Expansion Strategy Keeps Delivering Results

Costco Wholesale Corporation Reports June Sales Results; Reports June Net Sales Of $29.24B, Up 10.6% For Five Weeks Ended July 5, 2026;  Reports Net Sales Of $250.43B For First 44 Weeks, Up 10.1%; U.S. Comparable Sales Up 10.6% For 5 Weeks, Canada Up 3.7%

turning.explanation: COST 在 2026-07-09 下跌主要是因为投资者对销售增长放缓感到不安，且由于估值较高导致其容错空间较小。尽管公布了 6 月销售数据，但市场对增长放缓和激烈的价格竞争产生了担忧，引发股价回调。

drivers.text: Costco 销售增长放缓令投资者感到不安，引发股价下跌。
